bibliographic.title: The Cats of Crossed Elder
bibliographic.author: Jennifer S. Lange
bibliographic.description:
A delve into a petrified titan

The Cats of Crossed Elder is a short gamebook about travelling into an Elder, a titanic petrified corpse from ages past. Players look for a lost animal species whose abilities can spread hope for scientific progress.

The game is forgiving. Don't worry about maneuvering yourself into a dead end or failing at a challenge. There are skill rolls in the background. When you are given a question but get a shrug, it may be that your character didn't roll high enough for a better answer. Sometimes the question is not "did you make it", but "which event occurs". This will never cause you disadvantages, only change the story.

This game ties into the The Elders setting. Find more Elders games here.

Content warning: Features themes of body horror, mutilation, and animal cruelty.
